# PaperSpine5 Figure Studies 301-308 - website release

This package contains exactly three asset groups and only PaperSpine5-authored figures:

- `01_pdf/`: one vector-native 8-page publication PDF, one figure per page.
- `02_images/`: eight publication PNGs and eight editable SVGs.
- `03_mobile/`: eight exact-1:2 single-figure pages and four tightly cropped, full-width two-figure walls.

No literature figure, reference artwork, citation card, DOI, author, venue, or reference metadata is packaged here. Internal reference evidence remains outside this public release directory for provenance only.

The mobile artwork contains no added headline, frame, caption, task number, or relationship claim. Wall canvases are content-bound rather than padded to an arbitrary phone ratio. All scientific results are synthetic demonstration data or illustrative mechanisms, not empirical evidence.
